
```{r include=TRUE}
Caption <- CAP  |> sprintf(min(TR_TARGET),max(TR_TARGET),Vs30_TARGET,p_TARGET)
# Caption <- ""
UHS <- UHSTable[Vs30==Vs30_TARGET & SM=="openquake" & ID=="nrc_v3.19.1" & TR %in% TR_TARGET]
DATA <- UHS[Vs30==Vs30_TARGET & p == p_TARGET,.(ID=paste0("TR= ",TR," yr"),Y=Sa,X=Tn)][order(X)]|> unique()
DATA[X==0,X:=0.001]
PLOT <- buildPlot(
  library = "highcharter",
  yAxis.label =TRUE,
  plot.type="line",
  legend.layout="horizontal",
  legend.show=TRUE,
  xAxis.log = FALSE,
  yAxis.log = FALSE,
  line.size=THICK_LINE_SIZE,
  xAxis.legend="Tn [s]",
  yAxis.legend="Sa [g]",
  group.legend="TR [yr]",
  data=DATA,
  plot.subtitle = Caption)
PLOT
```
